title: Can I CRUSH Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess vs online humans (1+2 to 5+5 clocks); goal 5 wins, finishes 5-1 over six games. G1 (white) Horse Eats First vs opp 'Stockfish' drawback (can't make the move Stockfish would make) - win; G2 Sibling Rivalry vs opp Friendly Fire - win; G3 Unlucky vs opp Rook on the Seventh - loss; G4 Cowering in Fear vs opp Torpedoes - win; G5 Edgelord vs opp Bishop Fan Club - win; G6 (black) Elephants Fear Mice vs opp True Gentleman - win.
rules: Standard setup and moves; each player is dealt one secret random drawback (card with Easy-Hard difficulty slider); the opponent's drawback is revealed when the game ends ('Your opponent's drawback was ...').
No check/checkmate: kings may move into or stay in attack; capturing the enemy king wins.
Breaking or failing your drawback condition makes you lose (or the move is simply illegal, depending on drawback wording).
Players may chat/rename to bluff or reveal drawbacks.

Drawbacks in this video: Horse Eats First - as long as you have a knight, you can only capture with knights. (Opponent's unpronounceable one) - you can't make the move Stockfish would make. Sibling Rivalry - you cannot move a piece to a square adjacent to an opponent's piece of the same type. Friendly Fire - (text not read). Unlucky - can't move to half of the squares, re-randomized every move. Rook on the Seventh - by move 15 you must move one of your rooks to the seventh rank. Cowering in Fear - you can't move a piece of less value than one your opponent has taken. Torpedoes - if you made a non-capturing pawn move last turn and can move it again, you must. Edgelord - must have at least as many pieces on the rim as your opponent (UI shows 'Yours: 8, Theirs: 6'). Bishop Fan Club - you must promote to bishops. Elephants Fear Mice - your non-pawn pieces can't capture pawns. True Gentleman - can't capture queens.
win_condition: Capture the enemy king. Goal: 5 wins.
